intro: In Stormwind, Malin asks for help recovering relics from fallen Stromgarde. Archmage Malin sends seasoned Alliance adventurers north to Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, where an expedition seeks the magical relics left behind when Stromgarde fell.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. You have the look of an adventurer about you, and I have a task that needs some tending to.
Archmage Trelane, my original master, fled Stromgarde in the Arathi Highlands not too long ago, and he's asked me to help him in recovering some of the items he left behind.
The city fell under siege, and he attempted to defend the Tower of Arathor, but to no avail. I have agents in the Highlands already, but they've requested I send more aid. Are you interested?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, Malin sent ye? I don't care if Muradin rose up from the dead and whisked ye here on a dragon. I'm busy! Talk to Kryten if you need somethin'.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
